name: io.github.sisygoboom/unlimitedtts-mcp
title: UnlimitedTTS
description: Quote-first, non-custodial x402 text-to-speech with spend policy, MP3 artifacts, and receipts.

environmentVariables.name: UNLIMITEDTTS_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: Runtime environment. Defaults to production; staging explicitly selects the staging API and Base Sepolia pins.

environmentVariables.name: UNLIMITEDTTS_MAX_USDC_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Maximum authorized USDC amount for one synthesis.

environmentVariables.name: UNLIMITEDTTS_ROLLING_24H_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Maximum committed, unknown, and reserved spend in a rolling 24-hour window.

environmentVariables.name: UNLIMITEDTTS_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: Absolute approved directory for private MP3 artifacts and sanitized receipts.
